label: Lives-only act consequentialism fails, from the transplant verdict (inference)
rule: Theorem reuse, rewriting by the case description and computation on the finite case
meaning: Contrapositive of the act-consequentialist transplant derivation. In this frame transplant and footbridge are one formal case with two verdicts, not independent data; they share defeaters such as personal force and using a person. Conditional on the open prima facie verdict.
